records.subject: spec-guard-release-artifact
evidence: result:the package was built from the v0.29.0 tag with git archive of .claude-plugin and plugins/spec-guard plus ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json, the method that rebuilt v0.24.0 file-for-file identical to its published asset
result:release-package.py validated the artifact directory before archiving and again after extracting the archive; the archive contains no AppleDouble entries
result:the locally built archive and the downloaded published GitHub asset both have SHA-256 802dbd6759f4f349da29c5597b032f305644d42144ec59770c602ade9840b2f0, matching the digest GitHub reports
content:the package contains add-module --interrupt in hooks/module-insert.py, the Paused line in hooks/module_stage.py and the module-interrupt boundary in hooks/proposal_mainline_review.py
result:the required GitHub Actions checks validate (ubuntu-latest) and validate (macos-latest) passed on 325320e, the release pull request head whose tree is identical to the tagged merge commit
